selfie.definition: n. a photograph that you take of yourself, usually with a mobile phone. Selfies are often published using social media

selfing.translation: 自花授精; 自交; 自体受精

selfish.definition: a. concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
selfish.translation: a. 自私的, 利己主义的, 自我中心的

selfishly.translation: adv. 自私地, 自我中心地, 任性地

selfishness.definition: n. stinginess resulting from a concern for your own welfare and a disregard of others
selfishness.translation: n. 自我中心, 利己主义, 任性

selfishnesses.definition:
plural of selfishness
n. stinginess resulting from a concern for your own welfare and a disregard of others
selfishnesses.translation: (selfishness 的复数) n. 自我中心, 利己主义, 任性
